correctness.rationale: The explicit quartic has unit Jacobian ideals on all four affine charts. Six exact Grassmannian-cell Groebner ideals give five reduced geometric lines and incidence graph A3+A2. For each of four graph symmetries, exact GF2 linear lifting constraints on sixteen entries yield a one-dimensional matrix space, a result stable under field extension; two cases are singular, one is identity, and the sole remaining invertible candidate fails polynomial preservation by the absent X0^2 X3^2 monomial. Each scheme fiber lies inside P0 and is reduced or empty. The embedded script executes all certificates.
